svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 02/12 Sutro Tower in Fog (Rare)
svg.desc: Some evenings only the top of the tower pokes out, like a ship sailing on the fog. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
